data.headline: MTB rentals
data.description:
Bike Rentals 

Helmet, water, and bike permit are included, making your biking experience worry-free.
Advanced Booking and Flexible Timing
We recommend booking in advance to secure your bike rental. While we suggest at least 12 hours, we will do our best to accommodate your schedule.
data.cancellation_notes:
• 	Cancellations within 2 hours of the scheduled start time are non‑refundable.
• 	No‑shows are considered cancellations within the 2‑hour window and are non‑refundable.
• 	Weather & Safety Exceptions: If we must cancel due to unsafe weather or trail conditions, you may choose a full refund or reschedule at no cost.
How to Cancel or Reschedule
Please contact us by phone or email with your booking details. Refunds will be processed to the original payment method within 5–7 business days.
data.booking_notes:
Pickup Location: 📍 Corner of Sumner & Beacon Street, in front of Vons Market — a central and easy landmark to find.

Rental Details:

 Your bike will be delivered and ready at the time specified in your booking

 Includes 1 liter of water

 Helmet provided

 Interior bike permit included

Important Notes:

If you plan to bring your own pedals or helmet, please email or message us in advance

You are responsible for managing your Free Bicycle reservation — we will show you how to register your ride
